name: claude-code-notifier
description: Know when Claude Code is waiting on you: a sound, a system banner, and the name of the project that called. Works over SSH, WSL and containers.

enumDescriptions: Play a sound and show a system banner, alongside the VS Code notification.
Show a system banner, alongside the VS Code notification.
Play a sound, alongside the VS Code notification.
Show only the VS Code notification — no banner, no sound.
Do not notify for this event at all.
claudeCodeNotifier.permissionRequest.lev.description: What happens when Claude asks for permission to run a command.

enumDescriptions: The system's standard notification sound.
A brighter two-tone chime.
A short, clear bell.
A soft, low knock.
An insistent sound, for things that block you.
claudeCodeNotifier.permissionRequest.sou.description: The sound for a permission request.

claudeCodeNotifier.minTaskSeconds.description: Do not announce a finished task that took less than this many seconds. 0 announces every task.

claudeCodeNotifier.notificationDelay.description: Seconds to wait before playing sound and showing the system banner. If you dismiss the VS Code notification within this time, both are cancelled.

claudeCodeNotifier.suppressWhenFocused.description: Skip the sound and system banner when VS Code is already the active window. The VS Code notification still appears.
